sql: SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS used FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reason_code IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY used DESC LIMIT 3
explanation: The three reason codes used most on documents reviewed in October 2026.
assumptions: Both ask_applicant and escalate have reason codes
